hook: Your wage protections under federal law faced a direct threat inside the Code of Federal Regulations.

sections.voiceover: Your wage protections under federal law faced a direct threat inside the Code of Federal Regulations.
In 2025, officials targeted 9 parts of wage guidance. The Wage and Hour Division drafted a plan to remove rules. Where did those protections go?
Public comments questioned the benefits, but the Wage and Hour Division kept pushing.
b_roll: Public rulemaking notices on Federal Register

sections.voiceover: Federal regulators officially withdrew the proposal on October 7, 2026. The U.S. Department of Labor protected your standards. Code regulations keep every single rule intact.
